name.en: The game no longer crashes when you open your items during a battle
name.ja: 戦闘中に持ち物を開いてもゲームが落ちない

description.en: Opening your items while a battle is processing folds the enemy panel to zero height, and an enemy panel update at that moment crashes the game with a division by zero. The update now runs to the end while the panel is folded, and the panel is redrawn when it comes back.
description.ja: 戦闘の処理中に持ち物を開くと敵の欄が高さ 0 に畳まれ、そのときに敵の欄の更新が走ると 0 除算でゲームが落ちる。畳まれている間も更新を最後まで走らせ、欄が戻ったら描き直す。
